entities.name: Orla
entities.description: Mischievous faerie of unknown gender from Eldraine who helped prank and subdue Rankle.

entities.name: Rankle
entities.description: Mean-spirited faerie tricked into believing he would be crowned king.

entities.name: Mags
entities.description: Orla's friend who released the trap.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which the prank took place.

events.summary: Orla and friends set up an elaborate prank to trick Rankle into believing he is about to be crowned king.
events.quote: set up an elaborate prank to trick Rankle into believing he was about to be crowned king

events.summary: When Mags releases the trap, Orla helps subdue Rankle.
events.quote: Orla helped subdue Rankle during the ensuing struggle

events.summary: Orla and the others firmly reject Rankle's plea to stay.
events.quote: they firmly rejected Rankle's plea to stay

relations.note: Disdains his cruelty and helped trap him.
relations.quote: Orla harbors a certain disdain for cruelty
